title: The report shows the work order number and inspected date correctly
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in with ‘Work orders - View’ (enough to open a work order and view its inspection report), plus the inspection roles needed to run one (‘Work order lines - Create & Edit’).
  • A completed inspection on a work order whose number carries a branch prefix (work order numbers carry the workplace’s prefix, for example S1-2252).
custom_steps:
1. Confirm the work order number appears without a leading hash in both the header and the running header.
2. Confirm the inspected date shows without a time.
3. Confirm the work order number includes its branch prefix (S1-2252 rather than S-2252).
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The work order number appears without a leading hash, in both the header and the running header.
  • The inspected date shows without a time.
  • The work order number includes its branch prefix, so S1-2252 rather than S-2252.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-8181, story SV-9111 (S13 — Customer-facing inspection report); Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, section S13; read on 22 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S13-R6: “The work order number will appear without a leading hash, in both the header and the running header”
  • S13-R7: “The inspected date will show without a time”
  • S13-R8: “The work order number will include its branch prefix, so S1-2252 rather than S-2252”
